snippet.title: Animula Nook | Gameplay Trailer | Full 8-Min Demo
snippet.description:
Shrink into Animula Nook 🌱 — here’s your first full look at the gameplay!
🎮 Wishlist on Steam: https://play.animulanook.com/Gameplay
💬 Join our official Discord to get test access: https://discord.gg/animulanook

In this 8-min demo, you’ll see how life unfolds in our tiny world:
 ✨ COLLECT sunlight, raindrops, and other precious resources
 ✨ BUILD dream homes from milk cartons, teacups, and spice jars
 ✨ EXPLORE lush houseplant forests and mysterious forgotten wells
 ✨ BEFRIEND whimsical folk and watch their stories come alive

Everyday objects become foundations of a world full of cozy adventures.
This is Animula Nook gameplay — tiny tasks leading to big stories. ✨

#AnimulaNook
